account_purpose_chk.name: account_purpose_chk
account_purpose_chk.value: "account"."purpose" is null or (char_length("account"."purpose") between 1 and 24 and "account"."purpose" = btrim("account"."purpose"))

allocation_rule_label_chk.name: allocation_rule_label_chk
allocation_rule_label_chk.value: "allocation_rule"."label" is null or length("allocation_rule"."label") between 1 and 60

allocation_rule_target_chk.name: allocation_rule_target_chk
allocation_rule_target_chk.value: ("allocation_rule"."target_account_id" is not null)::int + ("allocation_rule"."target_goal_id" is not null)::int = 1

allocation_rule_value_chk.name: allocation_rule_value_chk
allocation_rule_value_chk.value:
("allocation_rule"."mode" = 'fixed' and "allocation_rule"."amount" > 0 and "allocation_rule"."basis_points" is null)
				or ("allocation_rule"."mode" = 'percent' and "allocation_rule"."basis_points" between 1 and 10000 and "allocation_rule"."amount" is null)
				or ("allocation_rule"."mode" = 'rest' and "allocation_rule"."amount" is null and "allocation_rule"."basis_points" is null)

bill_override_skip_chk.name: bill_override_skip_chk
bill_override_skip_chk.value: not "bill_override"."skipped" or ("bill_override"."new_due_date" is null and "bill_override"."amount" is null and "bill_override"."account_id" is null)

bill_override_effect_chk.name: bill_override_effect_chk
bill_override_effect_chk.value: "bill_override"."skipped" or "bill_override"."new_due_date" is not null or "bill_override"."amount" is not null or "bill_override"."account_id" is not null

bill_payment_paid_chk.name: bill_payment_paid_chk
bill_payment_paid_chk.value: ("bill_payment"."paid_currency" is null and "bill_payment"."paid_amount" is null) or ("bill_payment"."paid_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' and "bill_payment"."paid_amount" > 0)

ledger_txn_to_currency_chk.name: ledger_txn_to_currency_chk
ledger_txn_to_currency_chk.value:
("ledger_txn"."type" = 'transfer' and "ledger_txn"."to_currency" is not null and "ledger_txn"."to_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'
				and (("ledger_txn"."to_currency" = "ledger_txn"."currency" and "ledger_txn"."to_amount" is null) or ("ledger_txn"."to_currency" <> "ledger_txn"."currency" and "ledger_txn"."to_amount" > 0)))
				or ("ledger_txn"."type" <> 'transfer' and "ledger_txn"."to_currency" is null and "ledger_txn"."to_amount" is null)

ledger_txn_transfer_chk.name: ledger_txn_transfer_chk
ledger_txn_transfer_chk.value: ("ledger_txn"."type" = 'transfer' and "ledger_txn"."to_account_id" is not null and ("ledger_txn"."to_account_id" <> "ledger_txn"."account_id" or "ledger_txn"."to_currency" is distinct from "ledger_txn"."currency")) or ("ledger_txn"."type" <> 'transfer' and "ledger_txn"."to_account_id" is null)

memory_fact_scores_chk.name: memory_fact_scores_chk
memory_fact_scores_chk.value: "memory_fact"."importance" between 1 and 5 and "memory_fact"."confidence" between 0 and 100 and "memory_fact"."fade_weight" between 0.1 and 1

notebook_shape_chk.name: notebook_shape_chk
notebook_shape_chk.value: length("notebook"."title") <= 80 and length("notebook"."summary") <= 200 and ("notebook"."kind" = 'extra' or ("notebook"."title" = '' and "notebook"."deleted_at" is null))

notebook_page_shape_chk.name: notebook_page_shape_chk
notebook_page_shape_chk.value: length("notebook_page"."title") between 1 and 80 and length("notebook_page"."text") <= 30000 and "notebook_page"."version" >= 1 and "notebook_page"."seen_version" >= 0 and "notebook_page"."position" >= 0

calendar_event_text_chk.name: calendar_event_text_chk
calendar_event_text_chk.value: length("calendar_event"."title") between 1 and 300 and length("calendar_event"."notes") <= 4000 and length("calendar_event"."location") <= 300
